title.sr: Admin panel: šta vidim čim se prijavim (telefon)
title.en: The admin panel: what I see right after signing in (phone)

intro.sr: Početna stranica administracije je kontrolna tabla: u jednom pogledu pokazuje šta čeka na odluku, šta je danas na rasporedu i kakvo je opšte stanje. Ovo je prvo mesto koje pogledate svako jutro. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: The admin home page is a control board: in one glance it shows what is waiting for a decision, what is on today and the general state of things. This is the first place to look every morning. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
